<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FAFAFA"/>
  
  <!-- status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="28" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="19" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">9:41</text>
  <line x1="326" y1="18" x2="326" y2="13" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="331" y1="18" x2="331" y2="11" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="336" y1="18" x2="336" y2="9" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="347" cy="14" r="2.2" fill="#323232"/>
  <line x1="343" y1="17" x2="351" y2="17" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="360" y="9" width="21" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="362" y="11" width="15" height="7" rx="1" fill="#323232"/>
  <rect x="381" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#323232"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <rect x="0" y="28" width="390" height="64" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="92" x2="390" y2="92" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="67" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">Cancel</text>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="66" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Edit Personal Data</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="330" y="45" width="42" height="30" rx="15" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <text x="351" y="65" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Done</text>
  </g>

  <!-- profile summary -->
  <rect x="17" y="108" width="356" height="95" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.04"/>
  <rect x="16" y="106" width="356" height="95" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="153" r="31" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
  <text x="65" y="161" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="24" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">AM</text>
  <text x="112" y="143" font-family="Roboto" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Alicia Morgan</text>
  <text x="112" y="166" font-family="Roboto" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">@alicia.morgan</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="112" y="176" width="105" height="18" rx="9" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
    <text x="164" y="189" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">Traveler since 2021</text>
  </g>

  <!-- form heading -->
  <text x="20" y="237" font-family="Roboto" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Personal information</text>
  <text x="20" y="257" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Keep your details up to date for smoother bookings.</text>

  <!-- first name -->
  <text x="20" y="286" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#5F5E65">FIRST NAME</text>
  <rect x="18" y="294" width="354" height="49" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="33" y="325" font-family="Roboto" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#323232">Alicia</text>
  <line x1="347" y1="314" x2="355" y2="322" stroke="#A8A8AC" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="355" y1="322" x2="347" y2="330" stroke="#A8A8AC" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- last name -->
  <text x="20" y="370" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#5F5E65">LAST NAME</text>
  <rect x="18" y="378" width="354" height="49" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="33" y="409" font-family="Roboto" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#323232">Morgan</text>
  <line x1="347" y1="398" x2="355" y2="406" stroke="#A8A8AC" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="355" y1="406" x2="347" y2="414" stroke="#A8A8AC" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- email -->
  <text x="20" y="454" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#5F5E65">EMAIL ADDRESS</text>
  <rect x="18" y="462" width="354" height="49" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="33" y="493" font-family="Roboto" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#323232">alicia.morgan@email.com</text>
  <circle cx="348" cy="486" r="8" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
  <polyline points="344,486 347,489 352,483" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- phone -->
  <text x="20" y="538" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#5F5E65">PHONE NUMBER</text>
  <rect x="18" y="546" width="354" height="49" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="31" y="561" width="42" height="20" rx="4" fill="#EBEBEB"/>
  <text x="52" y="575" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#323232">+1</text>
  <line x1="81" y1="556" x2="81" y2="585" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="94" y="577" font-family="Roboto" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#323232">(415) 555-0186</text>

  <!-- date of birth -->
  <text x="20" y="622" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#5F5E65">DATE OF BIRTH</text>
  <rect x="18" y="630" width="354" height="49" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="33" y="661" font-family="Roboto" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#323232">June 14, 1992</text>
  <rect x="340" y="644" width="16" height="15" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.3"/>
  <line x1="340" y1="648" x2="356" y2="648" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.3"/>
  <line x1="344" y1="641" x2="344" y2="647" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.3"/>
  <line x1="352" y1="641" x2="352" y2="647" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.3"/>

  <!-- helper and save reminder -->
  <text x="20" y="702" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Your name should match your government-issued ID.</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="718" width="350" height="37" rx="8" fill="#FFD3D1" opacity="0.5"/>
    <circle cx="39" cy="736" r="9" fill="#DB6186"/>
    <text x="39" y="740" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">i</text>
    <text x="56" y="741" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#7A1851">Changes will apply to future bookings.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="775" width="390" height="69" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="775" x2="390" y2="775" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,800 49,792 59,800" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <rect x="43" y="799" width="12" height="12" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="49" y="831" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="127" cy="801" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="133" y1="807" x2="139" y2="813" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="127" y="831" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Explore</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="183" y="794" width="24" height="17" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="188" y1="798" x2="202" y2="798" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <line x1="188" y1="803" x2="198" y2="803" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <text x="195" y="831" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Trips</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="293" cy="799" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="293" cy="796" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <ellipse cx="293" cy="805" rx="6" ry="3" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <circle cx="303" cy="793" r="3" fill="#DB6186"/>
    <text x="293" y="831" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="365" cy="801" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="365" cy="801" r="2" fill="#949499"/>
    <line x1="365" y1="795" x2="365" y2="798" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <line x1="365" y1="804" x2="365" y2="807" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <line x1="359" y1="801" x2="362" y2="801" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <line x1="368" y1="801" x2="371" y2="801" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <text x="365" y="831" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">More</text>
  </g>
</svg>
